model_note: 工具返回值仅有 image_url 与 output_hint，没有公开底层模型名；不推定具体模型。
mode: built-in image generation; no CLI/API fallback

reference_roles.prince: faceted low-poly matte material guide only; adult proportions follow Bernard and Ferryman
reference_roles.bernard: visual style, adult proportion, board layout
reference_roles.ferryman: visual style, adult proportion, board layout; do not copy silhouette

crop_box_convention: [left, top, right, bottom], pixels, right/bottom exclusive; native source 1672 x 941; no resampling
postprocess: User-authorized deterministic column cropping with macOS sips. Source images copied intact to sheet.png; all originals retained in ~/.codex/generated_images/. One local crop correction: sips treated (0,0) as centered for hero; explicit x=1 crop corrected all three. No character-generation retries.

generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a polished wide landscape character production concept board, preferably 3072 x 1728 or the highest available landscape resolution, for ONE single character identity. Match the supplied CAPTAIN BERNARD and THE FERRYMAN reference boards: sculpted faceted low-poly 3D volumes, visible planar angular cuts on skin, hair and cloth, simple matte material, restrained wear, quiet soft studio lighting with ground-contact shadows, clean warm grey background, dark English serif title and view labels, fine muted-brown divider rules, small unlabelled palette swatches. Adult character proportions like Bernard, roughly 6.5–7 heads tall, no chibi, no baby-face, no smooth cartoon rendering, no photorealism, no painterly brushwork. The prince image is a MATERIAL reference only; do not copy his crown, cape, armor or proportions. Bernard and Ferryman are STYLE and BOARD-LAYOUT references only, do not copy their character or equipment.
CRITICAL BOARD LAYOUT for clean separate crops: LEFT 31% of canvas: one large full-body 3/4 HERO illustration, fully contained, feet visible, all held props inside this column, generous margin. MIDDLE 50%: character title across the top, then three full-body orthographic-style FRONT / SIDE / BACK views in three separate equal columns, truly exact frontal, true side profile facing right, true rear. These three views have exactly equal character height and head scale, top of head aligned, feet all on the very same horizontal ground line. Identical relaxed neutral standing pose, arms straight slightly away from body, hands empty with no held props, no detached floating props near these views. Same identity, costume, proportions and features consistently rotated, never mirrored. RIGHT 19%: detached prop study column with props clearly separated, no character here, plus a small palette at bottom. Do not cross column boundaries. Keep the empty column gutters wide enough to crop.
Only the exact English character title plus HERO, FRONT, SIDE, BACK, PROPS may be readable text. No narrative, no ages printed, no invented lore, no watermark, no busy environment, no parchment collage, no unrelated characters, no royal cloak, no worn crown or halo. Multiple views of this one character only are allowed.
CHARACTER: Matilda — the Stitcher. Exact title: "MATILDA — THE STITCHER".
A 38-year-old undead female naval field surgeon, compact sturdy ADULT build and competent amused expression; tied-back auburn hair in a practical small low bun, mature angular ashen face with a couple of SMALL neat sewn seams, no gore. One exposed anatomical BONE wrist, not mechanical, a tiny restrained teal soul-light on that seam. Both hands gloved. Practical patched BROWN leather surgical apron over FADED NAVY tunic, rolled sleeves, worn sturdy boots, belt with a closed leather instrument roll. Work clothing, no armor, no noble regalia.
HERO: busy capable pose carefully holding ONE curved surgical needle threaded with one visible fine thread between her two gloved hands, needle lifted just enough to read against background, subtle humorous expression. Keep both hands anatomically clear.
FRONT/SIDE/BACK: identical neutral stance, hands EMPTY. Garment seams, bun, belt roll and apron straps consistent across rotations. Apron covers front; crossing apron straps visible on back. The same one exposed bone wrist is retained anatomically on her LEFT arm in every view; other wrist intact. No open wound.
PROPS: separate studies of exactly a curved surgical needle with thread, one thread spool, surgical shears, and one opened leather instrument roll containing simple surgical instruments. No other equipment. Palette: ashen grey, brown leather, faded navy, auburn, dull bone, very small muted teal.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: hammer, anvil, smith tools, mechanical prosthesis, mechanical hand, crown, royal cape, royal heraldry, gore.
generations.review_notes: 首轮生成，未退回。已逐张查看拆分文件：38岁成年军医方向、赤棕扎发、灰白皮肤整齐缝线、褪蓝军服、棕皮围裙、卷袖手套、单侧露骨腕与少量青绿魂光；主立绘持弯针线，配件含针线、线轴、外科剪、器械卷；未见锤、铁砧、机械义肢、王冠或王室披风。正侧背目视等高、同地线、空手，左腕骨与右髋器械卷朝向对应。已知不足：主立绘的露骨段延及短段前臂，弯针为展示而放大；手套握持遮挡部分手指，未逐根确认；不能据此认定为几何精确建模图。
